A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Before we talk.

Which service should I start with?

If you are unsure, tell us what you are trying to solve. We can discuss whether accounting, tax support, advisory or a combination best fits your needs.

What should I prepare for an initial discussion?

A brief description of your business, the support you need and any relevant deadlines is a useful start. We can then explain which records may be needed.

How are fees agreed?

Contact us to discuss your requirements. The scope of work and fees can be agreed based on the services and level of support you need.
